behavior: No permission request or registration POST on mount. Explicit enable validates secure PWA readiness/configuration/key, then uses the actual PushSubscription and registered VAPID key.

Permission, account push preference and server device registration are separate. Device enable never changes account preferences. RX040 uses actual Messages/Assignments preferences and the existing versioned update command.

Only HTTP200 typed Web acknowledgment followed by the own active row with matching ID and creation timestamp can clear uncertainty and enable display. Correlation is persisted across reload/manual read; a mismatched timestamp cannot become active later.

Only user ID, fingerprint digest, registration ID, actual version, creation timestamp and uncertainty metadata are stored. Raw endpoint and subscription keys are not stored by the app. Local correlation is never an ownership/permission grant.
Known registration lookup reads own paginated records, including revoked records to obtain actual reactivation version. Missing rows or concurrent inconsistent pages do not prove inactive identity.
Deletion freezes the actual row identity and rereads it before the id-only unversioned command. Last-seen/version changes alone are not invented deletion preconditions. Only204 confirms removal.

Delete settlement refreshes the list even after the dialog was dismissed. It never repeats DELETE and does not show a completed-action notice in a dismissed dialog. Other account devices remain. Fresh confirmed revocation stops local display; login sessions and account preferences are untouched.

Account changes/logout disable display for an earlier account through the existing public-only worker. Worker settings messages are same-origin and serialized; generic lock-screen text and user filtering remain.
Ordinary account push switches preserve returned inactive quiet-hour values. The existing complete preference form retains its earlier normalization behavior.
A later empty page preserves Previous and uses a page-scoped empty label when totalCount is positive; it does not claim that the whole account has no devices.

The existing modal variant supplies mobile bottom sheet/tablet dialog/desktop drawer. Focus traps, Escape, return to the row or heading when removed,44px targets, and320/390/430x400200percent text have focused browser checks. No new CSS patch layer was needed.

limitations: Mutation/error tests use declared browser doubles. A supplemental read-only Chrome case uses actual native worker/notification APIs without a permission/register action. Physical permission prompts and push delivery remain unverified; no CUA permission action or live notification was sent.

The own-device list exposes no endpoint, subscription fingerprint, friendly device name or phone form factor. Current-browser identity requires the typed registration acknowledgment, actual local subscription fingerprint and matching own list row; other labels use the actual platform.

The first lost acknowledgment leaves no registration ID to correlate. Platform-only list rows cannot determine which belongs to the subscription.
